reviews.title: Great until it broke in 1 month
reviews.comment:
The headset is super comfortable. It is light and the sounds are great. The product looked new and would have been a 5 star review. However, with very light use (every other day) the right ear became loose and the earmuff would not fit flush anymore. It looked like a loose screw and trying to turn it back in did not work. Eventually the whole right earmuff detached and broken plastic was the culprit (and probably why it wouldn't tighten back in).
Great price but you get what you pay for it. If I'm breaking it in around 1 month with sporadic use the quality control isn't great.
reviews.author: Addie
